The '''border assault post''', originally the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] '''Waypoint Station Morne'''&mdash;officially '''Republic Outpost Four'''&mdash;during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], was a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] military station built on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. It served as a secure base for [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] and medical personnel during the reconstruction of Taris. It was located east of [[Tower command station|Waypoint Stations Aurek]] and [[Bomber command post|Waypoint Station Draay]], in the [[Verdant Marshes]] section of the [[Tularan Marsh]] region on Taris.<ref name="TOR" />

==Personnel==
[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Yajak]] led Waypoint Station Morne as well as the various Republic scouts, riflemen and officers based within. Private [[Selro]] was one of these Republic soldiers. Also located at Morne were two non-combat Republic personnel; Archivist [[Wintag]] and [[Hacken Berge]]. Both were [[Historian/Legends|historians]] working with the [[Taris Resettlement Initiative]].<ref name="TOR" /><ref name="TOR:TA">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' - Quest: The Archive</ref><ref name="TOR:CH">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' - Quest: Chasing History</ref>
